evals.name: refuse-newer
evals.prompt: The code reads a journal with schema 3; it knows up to 2.
evals.expected_output: Refuses with an error that names the version and tells to update fsd. Does NOT try to read it.

evals.name: migration-idempotent
evals.prompt: Write the migration from schema 1 to 2.
evals.expected_output: Makes it idempotent and tests it on a real v1 file, twice. Never a migration without that test.
